author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the launch trailer for River Runners, a cooperative multiplayer adventure where you and up to 3 friends must work together to survive a dangerous, ever-changing river. Each player occupies a single seat in the raft, controlling a paddle on their side. Only by paddling in sync can you effectively steer and stay on course. Communication is vital as you react to sudden obstacles, sharp turns, and unexpected events. River Runners is available now on PC (Steam).
title: River Runners - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the release window trailer for Sky Legends: An Aeropostal Epic, a historical virtual reality adventure developed by SUPER AC. Dive into the legendary adventures of the pioneers of civil aviation in the 1920s. In virtual reality, fully playable with hand tracking, step into the shoes of the pilots and key figures of this era to take on the challenges of the first commercial air crossings. Sky Legends: An Aeropostal Epic is coming to PC in 2026.
title: Sky Legends: An Aeropostal Epic - Official Release Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the launch trailer for Priest Simulator: Vampire Show, a first-person action, hack-and-slash simulator developed by Asmodev. Players take the role of Orlok, a vampire who unexpectedly becomes a priest in the village of San de Ville. The goal is to care for the faithful and fight evil in order to return to Hell. Priest Simulator: Vampire Show is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Priest Simulator: Vampire Show - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for SinsKiller, an isometric action arcade shooter set in a Dante-inspired Hell developed by Kimera Forge. Once a legendary battle-mage, you unleashed forbidden magic that shattered the soul of the one you loved. Now bound to Hell, you descend into its depths in search of redemption. As you plunge deeper, you are accompanied by a mysterious spirit-like energy globe guiding you from one circle to the next. Silent, watchful, and eternal, it leads you through Hell’s arenas as you confront the living embodiment of your sins. SinsKiller is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: SinsKiller - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Assemble your squad of cloned super soldiers against the evil M.E.G.A. Corp army! Each Merc totes their own arsenal and personal tactics to tackle the robot horde. Call in your Merc clone reinforcements, pick their optimal specialization tree for your operation, and supercharge their combat effectiveness with hi-tech Gear to build a horde-slaying killer squad! Survivor Mercs is launching on April 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Survivor Mercs - Official Release Date Trailer
